summary: Build foundational BCMS knowledge with ISO 22301 Foundation training. Prepare for the PECB exam and apply for the Foundation credential.
audienceIntro: ISO 22301 Foundation is designed for people who need a clear grounding in BCMS concepts and requirements, whether they support continuity activities or advise on business continuity management.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO 22301 Foundation credential, you must complete the training course, pass the PECB ISO 22301 Foundation exam, and sign the PECB Code of Ethics. The credential has no professional experience, management-system audit or assessment experience, or BCMS project experience requirement.
